description:
Read an incoming EU e-invoice into one JSON shape: seller, buyer, dates, references, totals, VAT breakdown, payment/IBAN, lines and
attachments. Accepts UBL 2.1 Invoice/CreditNote or UN/CEFACT CII XML (XRechnung, Peppol BIS 3, Factur-X XML) in xml, or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X
PDF as base64 in pdf_base64. Use when asked to read, extract or book a received e-invoice. Values are returned as written in the invoice;
this does NOT validate it (use validate_einvoice for that).
name: parse_einvoice
